summary: Support Tickets (Bug Report) feature backend testing completed. All 17 tests passed successfully. All CRUD operations for support tickets work correctly. Both user and admin endpoints are functional.

POST /api/support/tickets.description: Creates bug reports/support tickets with type, subject, description, priority, page_url, browser_info

GET /api/support/tickets/mine.description: Returns user's own tickets, supports status filter

GET /api/support/admin/tickets.description: Admin endpoint - returns all tickets with pagination and filters (status, priority, type, company_id)

GET /api/support/admin/tickets/stats.description: Returns ticket statistics: total, open, in_progress, resolved, urgent_open, high_open, bugs, feature_requests

PATCH /api/support/admin/tickets/{ticket.description: Updates ticket status, priority, assigned_to, resolution_notes. Auto-sets resolved_at when status=resolved

DELETE /api/support/admin/tickets/{ticke.description: Deletes ticket (admin only), returns 404 for non-existent tickets

Authentication Guard.description: All endpoints require authentication (returns 401 without auth)

Admin Authorization.description: Admin endpoints check is_super_admin flag (returns 403 for non-admins)

critical_code_review_comments: Backend implementation is solid with proper auth guards and admin checks
MongoDB _id is properly excluded from all responses
Proper error handling with 404 for non-existent tickets
Pagination support with limit/offset in admin list endpoint

test_credentials.note: This user has is_super_admin=true which allowed admin endpoint testing

seed_data_creation: Test tickets created and cleaned up during tests
